@@ -166,0 +166,38 @@
+security-properties.argument=<filename>
+
+security-properties.description=\
+Override the security properties in the\n\
+conf/security/java.security configuration file with the properties in the\n\
+specified filename. Security properties with the same name are overridden\n\
+and security properties not present are added to the end of the\n\
+conf/security/java.security configuration file. Duplicate properties\n\
+(properties with the same name) and include statements in the original\n\
+java.security file are disallowed and treated as an error. Comments in the\n\
+properties file are ignored and not copied. If the properties file contains\n\
+an include statement, it is always added as the last line of the\n\
+conf/security/java.security configuration file, after any new security\n\
+properties that may have been added. The include filename does not need to\n\
+exist at jlink time. If the properties file contains duplicate properties,\n\
+the value of the last property is used.
+
+
+security-properties.usage=\
+\  --security-properties <filename>\n\
+\                            Override the security properties in the\n\
+\                            conf/security/java.security configuration file\n\
+\                            with the properties in the specified filename.\n\
+\                            Security properties with the same name are\n\
+\                            overridden and security properties not present\n\
+\                            are added to the end of the\n\
+\                            conf/security/java.security configuration file.\n\
+\                            Comments in the properties file are ignored and\n\
+\                            not copied. If the properties file contains an\n\
+\                            include statement, it is always added as the\n\
+\                            last line of the conf/security/java.security\n\
+\                            configuration file, after any new security\n\
+\                            properties that may have been added. The include\n\
+\                            filename does not need to exist at jlink time.\n\
+\                            If the properties file contains more than one\n\
+\                            property with the same name, the value of the\n\
+\                            last property is used.
+

@@ -238,0 +238,20 @@
+### Plugin `security-properties`
+
+Options
+:   `--security-properties=`*filename*
+
+Description
+:   Override the security properties in the `conf/security/java.security`
+    configuration file with the properties in the specified *filename*.
+    Security properties with the same name are overridden and security
+    properties not present are added to the end of the
+    `conf/security/java.security` configuration file. Duplicate properties
+    (properties with the same name) and include statements in the
+    original `java.security` file are disallowed and treated as an error.
+    Comments in the properties file are ignored and not copied. If the
+    properties file contains an include statement, it is always added as the
+    last line of the `conf/security/java.security` configuration file,
+    after any new security properties that may have been added. The include
+    filename does not need to exist at jlink time. If the properties file
+    contains duplicate properties, the value of the last property is used.
+
